mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the average return in declining-rate periods is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 7.5% over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, which may prompt the Fed to delay rate hikes or initiate cuts, increasing equity risk appetite and driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%, or the mean forward return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which increases the likelihood of a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to earnings contraction fears.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST < 850 and RSAFS < 410000, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 95.0 over the past two months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling a weakening economy and reduced corporate profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (measured via RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts indicates strong consumer confidence and demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS > 415000 and HOUST > 850, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 2.5% over three consecutive months increases the probability of aggressive Fed rate hikes, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in non-farm payroll growth below 50k over two months signals labor market softening, which may lead to a Fed pause or cut, increasing equity risk appetite and driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 50k, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized over the past six months indicates a weakening economy, which increases the likelihood of fiscal or monetary stimulus, boosting equity markets and producing positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 1.0%, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
